issues.name: Rear ride height too low
issues.details: Rear of the car sits a little too low. Check rear spring preload/spacers, spring condition, shock oil level and possible oil leakage, then adjust preload only as needed to restore correct ride height.

issues.name: Loose power connector
issues.details: Connector in the power path between the motor and battery is weak and slides out. Inspect the motor/ESC/battery connection, secure it properly, and replace the connector or terminal if it cannot hold firmly.

issues.name: Rear suspension sits high / limited play
issues.details: Rear of Car 2 currently sits high and has little suspension play. Check spring preload, shock movement/oil, binding in the rear arms/links and whether the aftermarket setup is limiting droop.

issues.name: Short servo/receiver lead needs rework
issues.details: Aftermarket servo has a very short/tight connection to the receiver. Connection is rough and should be redone properly; possible intermittent electrical contact should be checked.

upgrades.name: Red aluminum axle carriers / wheel hubs
upgrades.note: Aftermarket red metal carriers/hubs where the wheels attach, fitted front and rear. Exact manufacturer and part numbers still to confirm.

upgrades.name: Larger aftermarket wheels / tires
upgrades.note: Slightly larger aftermarket set, described as Ruiz VA. Performs very well. Exact brand/model and dimensions to confirm.

upgrades.name: Aftermarket steering servo
upgrades.note: Non-stock steering servo. Exact make/model to confirm. Current receiver lead is very short and needs a cleaner connection.

serviceHistory.title: Front suspension arms replaced
serviceHistory.details: Replaced both lower front suspension arms and the upper front arm on the vehicle-right side (right side when sitting in the car; appears left when viewed head-on). Black composite arms.

serviceHistory.title: Rear long red link replaced
serviceHistory.details: Replaced one of the two red rear suspension links, believed to be the longer link / toe link. Exact part and whether composite 7138 or aluminum 7138X still to confirm.
